facts.fact: 临近期末，Gardenpath 支开同学后单独问导师 Arch：如果野外考察依赖的前提可能不成立该怎么办
facts.anchor: Gardenpath worked up the courage to ask Professor Arch a question

facts.fact: Gardenpath 向 Arch 坦白：本科时观测了银河盘 70 万颗行星，发现一颗带明确呼吸信号
facts.anchor: observed seven hundred thousand planets in the galactic disk

facts.fact: Arch 警告：有权势的人把职业生涯押在「Spigot 不可能演化生命」上，这发现等于推翻几代科学共识
facts.anchor: have staked their careers on the idea that the Spigot cannot evolve life

facts.fact: Arch 嘱咐别高调宣称 Spigot 有生命，按「考官怀有敌意」来准备数据陈述
facts.anchor: present your data under the assumption that your examiners will be hostile

facts.fact: 此后 Arch 兑现导师承诺，课后留 Gardenpath 谈极端环境生命分析，并暗示用无法伪造的视频格式记录
facts.anchor: kept them after class to discuss analyzing life-forms in extreme environments

facts.fact: Oriel 指出 Gardenpath 的 galaxysuit 缺了吃的，掏出营养吸吸包，说服了从未想过工作也要吃饱的 Gardenpath
facts.anchor: pulled out a clever sippy packet for nutrients

facts.fact: Oriel 主动送出 oath receptor——Gardenpath 从没人送过誓约受体、也没被叫过挚友，随后学会折法并回赠了一枚
facts.anchor: Nobody had ever offered one to Gardenpath

facts.fact: 出发日 Gardenpath 在 Transit Hall 首次启用压缩功能，被压到不足常态千分之一，乘 travel spore 跳往目标行星
facts.anchor: squashed down to less than a thousandth of their normal size
